scope: Recheck only two critical findings from completed cumulative review

findings.claim: The frozen continuation DTO cannot prove that a resumed turn uses current task, member, binding, and approval authority after reassignment or revocation.
findings.evidence: ContinuationReceipt lacks the complete AttemptAuthority, root and approval-scope identity required by D5 and section 7. The schema and example preserve this omission.
findings.suggested_fix: Include complete fresh authority plus root/approval identity and require equality with the continuation-admission CAS.

findings.claim: The frozen DTO set does not carry failed or cancelled target outcomes into the continuation even though acceptance requires actual outcomes to reach the resumed coordinator.
findings.evidence: TargetOutcome appears only in TeamWait.wakeOutcomes; ContinuationReceipt only has artifact IDs, and TeamContextReceipt has no structured wait outcomes. Failed/cancelled targets can have no artifact.
findings.suggested_fix: Carry complete ordered outcomes or an immutable authorized outcome receipt into continuation and model-facing context; add failure/cancellation examples.
